descriptionNarrative.value: Proposal for a two-day strategy offsite in Stockholm for 24 attendees in October, including accommodation, daytime meeting space, lunches, and optional airport transfers and extra nights.

note.value: Assumed to be 4 October because the requested event dates are unknown.
One night assumed for all 24 attendees.
Two rooms assumed for both event days.
Airport transfers and extra nights are optional.

agentRationale.value: The proposal reflects the stated attendee count and assumptions. A weak catalog match was included for meeting services; accommodation, lunches, airport transfers, and extra-night services remain uncovered because no suitable catalog content was found.

reason.value: Alternative weak catalog match for meeting services.

text.value: The selected meeting service package is only a weak match for the requested meeting rooms.

warnings.reason: No acceptable catalog matches were returned for these requested services.
